entries.title: Qualifying to the flag, made easier to read: one line per race, up for places made up, down for places lost

values.label: places gained (final pass, default): each race a line from his grid slot, sorted so the 39 ahead / 7 held / 31 behind split is the picture; flips to race order by series
grid against flag (the version live now): qualified across, finished down, series key on the right
the ladder: the 77 races in order, one stroke each from his grid slot to the flag

entries.look: Career → More from the archive → Qualifying to the flag. Watch the lines grow from the grid-slot line; flip 'Biggest gain first' / 'In race order' and watch them regroup into the series; point at (or tap) a line to read the race.
